evidence: Live IRW items reproduce the identically named S1 XLSX columns exactly: expectations n=419 mean=4.9379 sd=0.9311 vs source 419/4.9379/0.9311; standards n=419 mean=4.8592 sd=0.9888 vs source 419/4.8592/0.9888. NOT established: the 1-7 response anchors or scale direction -- the source publishes none, and no option_text is shipped.
